changeSet.author: nfnn
changeSet.sql: alter table issued_receipt add column gift_count integer generated always as (json_array_length((frozen::json) -> 'gifts')) stored, add column total_amount_minor bigint generated always as ((((frozen::json) -> 'total') ->> 'amountMinor')::bigint) stored, add column certified_year integer generated always as (coalesce(receipt_year, (left((((frozen::json) -> 'gifts') -> 0) ->> 'receivedOn', 4))::integer)) stored
